discovery: Canonical HF453 CSV fails strict UTF-8 decoding; source contains non-UTF8 high bytes and mixed-looking note encodings. No biological score or model fit preceded this discovery.
HF453: Lossless Latin-1 byte-to-character mapping for CSV parsing, without claiming the supplier's original text encoding. Numerical, identity, year and status fields must be ASCII. Free-text damage notes are not decoded into causal death labels or model predictors.
HF355: ASCII source bytes; UTF-8 parsing is identical for declared ASCII fields.
raw_preservation: Original bytes, SHA256 and metadata remain unchanged; strict roundtrip encode-decode checks; no replacement-character decoding or rewritten raw CSV
scientific_protocol: Eligibility, outcome statuses, strata, target and scoring law unchanged from external_protocol.json; parser amendment only
